mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a single month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending is expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a single month, it signals a weakening in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economic impact of reduced construction activity is realized.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST declined by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in a single month, it signals an environment of high inflation and tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs increase.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both declined for two consecutive months.
